newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan ANA appoints new president.
newsitem.headline: Japan ANA appoints new president.

text.p: Japanese carrier All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) on Tuesday appointed a new president who said he will continue seeking further expansion in its international operations and further cost reduction efforts.

"I totally agree with the current president's policies of expanding international routes, and implementing cost reduction and rationalisation measures," Kenzo Yoshikawa, ANA's president designate, said at a news conference.

Yoshikawa, currently the president of ANA Real Estate Co Ltd, an ANA-related company, is expected to replace ANA's current president Seiji Fukatsu after approved by a board meeting in late June, the company said in a statement.
Yoshikawa added, however: "We (Yoshikawa and Fukatsu) may have differences in approach." He did not elaborate.
Fukatsu said that he would not continue taking responsibility as company president as he could not exercise his rights to appoint personnels, an ANA senior executive said.
Japanese media said that Fukatsu would step down in an abrupt move, after disagreements over management and personnel issues between him and ANA's chairman and honorary chairman.
They said Fukatsu had expressed his eagerness to work as president for more years.
